close_reason: Doc-only fix in commit 51b6255. Added inline reconnect/resume reminders at copy-pasteable spots inside the example loop (subscribe_events / connect_ws call sites + inner loop). Also fixed an incidental spec citation typo in ws_loop.rs ('RFC 8887 §4.3.5.1' -> '§4.3.5'). cargo build --examples + clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings green.
description: examples/sse_listen.rs near line 97 prints frame.id but never demonstrates threading it back. subscribe_events() takes last_event_id: Option<&str> as its second arg, but the example always passes None. The file header comment (line 28) says 'no retry' but a downstream consumer who copies the inner loop loses that context. Add a one-line comment near the println!: '// In production: track the last non-None id and pass as the second arg on subscribe_events() to resume.' Closes a real foot-gun without changing the example's scope.
title: examples/sse_listen.rs: no inline reminder to thread Last-Event-ID on reconnect
